findings.title: Outdated Server Software
findings.description: The web server is running an outdated version of Nginx which may contain known vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Update Nginx to the latest stable version to patch known vulnerabilities.

findings.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
findings.description: The application appears to be vulnerable to SQL injection on the 'id' parameter, allowing for potential data exfiltration or manipulation.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize all user inputs and use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection attacks.

findings.title: TLS 1.0 Enabled
findings.description: The server supports TLS 1.0, which is considered insecure and has known vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Disable TLS 1.0 and enforce TLS 1.2 or higher for secure communication.

findings.title: Insecure CORS Configuration
findings.description: The API endpoint does not restrict origins, potentially allowing cross-origin requests from any domain.
findings.recommendation: Configure CORS to allow only trusted origins to mitigate potential cross-site request forgery (CSRF) attacks.

findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) / Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR)
findings.description: The API allows access to user data without proper authorization checks, potentially enabling users to view or modify other users' information.
findings.recommendation: Implement robust authorization checks to ensure users can only access their own data.

findings.title: Cloudflare WAF Detected
findings.description: Cloudflare WAF is detected, which may help mitigate some common web attacks.
findings.recommendation: Continue to implement secure coding practices and regularly update security configurations.

python3 cors_scanner.py -u https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com && python3 ssrf_scanner.py -u https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com
kr scan https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com -w routes-large.kite && restler --target https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com
cme smb juice-shop.herokuapp.com -u '' -p '' && bloodhound-python -d juice-shop.herokuapp.com -u null -p null -c All
